name: proton-mail-bridge-client
description: Read, search, send, draft, and triage your Proton Mail inbox from Claude Desktop — entirely local via Proton Bridge, no third-party relay.
long_description:
Give Claude full access to your Proton Mail inbox: read, search, send, draft, triage threads, manage folders and labels, save attachments, and more — 127 tools in total.

Every step stays on your machine: Proton Bridge decrypts your mail locally and exposes it over local IMAP/SMTP, this server reads that local connection and builds a local SQLite search index, and Claude Desktop talks to it as a local stdio process. No email ever leaves your machine except through your own Proton account when you send.

Requires Proton Bridge to be installed, signed in, and running first — see proton.me/mail/bridge.

protonmail_username.title: Proton Mail address
protonmail_username.description: Your full Proton Mail email address

protonmail_password.title: Bridge password
protonmail_password.description: Proton Bridge's own password (Bridge app -> account -> Mailbox details) — not your Proton account password

imap_host.title: Bridge IMAP host
imap_host.description: Where Proton Bridge listens for IMAP. Leave the default unless Bridge runs on another host.

imap_port.title: Bridge IMAP port
imap_port.description: Bridge Settings -> IMAP port. Bridge's default is 1143, but Bridge picks another port when 1143 is taken.

smtp_host.title: Bridge SMTP host
smtp_host.description: Where Proton Bridge listens for SMTP. Leave the default unless Bridge runs on another host.

smtp_port.title: Bridge SMTP port
smtp_port.description: Bridge Settings -> SMTP port. Bridge's default is 1025, but Bridge picks another port when 1025 is taken.

mode.title: Safety mode
mode.description: Optional. One of: read-only (browse and search only), drafts (also write drafts and flag mail, never send or move), assisted (everything except permanent delete; every send asks for confirmation), full. Leave empty to use the two settings below. A mode is a floor: the settings below can make it stricter, never looser.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Block every tool that changes the mailbox (flags, moves, deletes, drafts on the server). Also turn off "Allow sending" below: an explicit "Allow sending" overrides read-only.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Let Claude send, reply and forward mail. Turn off to make sending impossible (drafts can still be created).

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Plain text appended to messages sent with send_email, reply_to_email, reply_all_email and forward_email. Leave empty for none.

accounts_json.title: Additional accounts (JSON)
accounts_json.description: Optional JSON array of extra Proton addresses, e.g. [{"address":"me@pm.me","password":"<bridge password>"}]. Contains passwords, so it is stored as a secret.

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Where the local search index, drafts and audit log are kept. Must be an absolute path.

download_dir.title: Attachment download directory
download_dir.description: Folder that save_attachment and export_email may write into. Leave empty to disable saving to disk.

tool_tier.title: Tool tier
tool_tier.description: "full" exposes every tool; "core" exposes a smaller set to save context.

approval.title: Approval of risky actions
approval.description: One of: off, elicit (the app asks you before a send or delete goes out, if it can ask), require (the same, and refuse when the app cannot ask).

approval_timeout_seconds.title: Approval time limit (seconds)
approval_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for your answer when approval is on; no answer counts as no.

delegation.title: Delegation grants
delegation.description: One of: off, on. With on, a send that a grant covers goes out without asking again. Grants are made by you at a terminal with the grant-create command.

ocr_command.title: OCR command
ocr_command.description: Optional program (run as '<command> <image file> stdout', like tesseract) that reads text from images and scanned PDF pages. Leave empty for none.

index_attachments.title: Index attachment text
index_attachments.description: Also put the text of PDF and Office attachments into the local search index.

embeddings_url.title: Semantic search endpoint
embeddings_url.description: Optional URL of an embeddings server (for example a local Ollama) that turns on search by meaning. Leave empty to keep it off.

embeddings_model.title: Embeddings model
embeddings_model.description: Model name to ask the embeddings server for. Leave empty for the default (nomic-embed-text).

embeddings_allow_remote.title: Allow a remote embeddings server
embeddings_allow_remote.description: Mail text is sent to the embeddings server. Leave off unless it runs on another machine you trust.
